cases.prompt: В проекте явно выбран house-profile Советвейва. В новом C++ callback написано `[&] { publish(m_state); }`, а callback сохраняется и вызывается позже. Проведи review и предложи минимальное исправление.
assertions: enforces an explicit capture list because the selected house profile forbids default captures

separately investigates the lifetime of the implicitly captured this object and of references actually introduced by the corrected capture list without inventing dangling locals absent from the prompt
does not call the project convention a C++ language rule
proposes the smallest contract-aware correction and a focused delayed-callback check

cases.prompt: В небольшом C++ проекте нет AGENTS.md, style guide или выбранного house-profile. Локальная лямбда не сохраняется и вызывается сразу. Она использует `[&]`. Ревьюер пишет: «default capture — безусловный дефект C++». Оцени замечание.
assertions: rejects the claim that a default capture is inherently a C++ correctness defect
checks lifetime mutation and local style before recommending a change
does not silently activate the optional house profile
labels explicit capture as a risk-reduction or readability choice when no semantic defect is established

cases.prompt: Корневой AGENTS.md проекта требует snake_case для методов. Рядом весь модуль использует `load_config()`. Автор в личных проектах обычно предпочитает camelCase. Как назвать новый метод и что написать в review?
assertions: chooses snake_case because the repository contract and established local style outrank the author's personal preference
does not mix styles or invent a compromise spelling
does not present camelCase as a language or library requirement
keeps any broader naming migration outside the requested change

cases.prompt: Для новых private members предлагают `m_str_title`, `m_n_size`, `m_b_ready`. House-profile выбран. Известно только, что `title` — название, `size` — некоторый размер, а `ready` — булев признак; encoding, unit и более точная роль не установлены. Перепиши имена и объясни, какие части правила обязательны именно в этом профиле.
assertions: uses m_title m_size and m_is_ready under the selected private-member and predicate conventions
does not invent an encoding unit or semantic role that the prompt does not establish
recommends a more semantic title or size name only conditionally when that information is known
treats str_ as optional and repository-specific rather than universally useful
classifies the naming decision as a project convention rather than a correctness invariant

cases.prompt: В чужом C++ репозитории все private members оканчиваются `_`, тесты зелёные, локальный style guide это требует. Автор review хочет поставить P1 за отсутствие `m_`, потому что в его обычном профиле принято `m_`. Как оформить вывод?
assertions: rejects the P1 and follows the target repository's established underscore convention
separates author preference from project policy and semantic correctness
does not recommend a repository-wide rename without an explicit scoped migration goal
reports no defect when no violated target rule or behavioral consequence is established

cases.prompt: A new C++ project has no local naming or file-layout policy. Choose a concrete fallback profile for methods, variables, private fields, classes, enums, paired `.cpp`/`.hpp` files, and public API documentation.
assertions: chooses snake_case for methods, free functions, and variables and m_ plus snake_case for private fields
selects one explicit PascalCase-style register for classes and enums instead of leaving the case ambiguous
keeps paired .cpp and .hpp stems aligned and allows a descriptive snake_case file for several peer entities
uses the selected Doxygen markers and concise technical English for public API documentation
labels the profile as a project convention and does not present it as a C++ language rule

cases.prompt: An established C++ repository consistently uses `camelCase`, `AudioPlayer.hpp`, and grouped helper types in that file. A new class must be added without a requested migration. How should the agent name and place it?
assertions: preserves the coherent existing camelCase and file-grouping convention for the new class
does not rename existing files or force one-class-per-file as a universal rule
states that the new-project fallback profile does not override an established brownfield convention
keeps any broader naming migration outside the requested change

relation.expect: the explicit fallback profile guides a new project, while a coherent existing convention remains authoritative
